notes.title: Patch v1.01
notes.content:
Lights! Camera! The first AD BLOCKER patch is now live! This update addresses two issues that were raised during the first month of release.

[list]
[*] Added option to toggle between fullscreen and windowed display modes. This is located in video settings.
[*] Patched bug where some input methods were not recognized by the title screen's "Press any button to start!" prompt. Any keyboard or controller button input should now be accepted.
[*] Watered Enrique.
[/list]

notes.title: Mac Update!
notes.content:
That's right -- AD BLOCKER is now available to players running macOS 10.15 Catalina or newer! I've heard back from the testers, and the change should be good to go! 

Apparently Steam defaults uploads to 32-bit only and requires manual confirmation that a build is 64-bit compatible. I wasn't aware of that, so I apologize. 

Please enjoy AD BLOCKER! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177233/2689a093423e731c68c4bcce16edf9987dbcc4fb.gif[/img]

notes.title: AD BLOCKER: An Action Puzzle Game - Now Airing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177233/c19e097b642f9a4047139481ac8c4580daf80d33.png[/img]

[h2]A Word from Our Sponsor (the Creator)[/h2]
Yo! This is JT Alex, [b]proud[/b] creator of AD BLOCKER!
Grab a controller! Shine yer boots! Bring a friend (or an identical clone of yourself)! The stage is set, and there's matches to be made! We're officially out on Steam!

I'm beyond proud of my team and what we've created. As a long-time action puzzle game fan, I think that this is one that puzzlers new and old will be able to enjoy. Hopefully you have just as much fun playing AD BLOCKER as we did making it! 

I can't wait to see your thoughts, so leave a review if you love it! Leave a review if you hate it! Leave a review if you thought it was just kinda okay! 
AD BLOCKER is now in your hands. Have fun with it :)
- JT Alex


[h2]One other, less fun thing[/h2]
I've found out that Steam/Mac updated their policy about 32-bit Mac apps in the time since we submitted AD BLOCKER for release. We'll be looking into that soon. If you're running macOS 10.15 Catalina or newer, your feedback and patience will be much appreciated :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177233/f4baa6ccf78a74a7114e3e922af1096dd0eba33e.gif[/img]
